Definition: of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian:--Urbanus.
BiblicalUsage: Urbanus was a fellow worker of Paul, greeted by name in the letter to the Romans as our helper in Christ, among the brethren Paul remembered with love. He worked alongside Paul, and Paul counted him among his helpers in Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Urbane is one of the quiet helpers of the gospel: Paul called him our helper in Christ, and that is a title worth having.
